phase_semantics: Append interval includes request receipt, file read/index/reset/lookup/import and append. Import interval is cumulative from receipt, not an additive isolated phase. No phase subtraction or kernel-cost attribution.

exit.elapsed_precision: UTC second-resolution start; interruption receipt end

failure.reason: pre-freeze service boundary audit: file read and index materialization were excluded; interrupted superseded epoch before aggregate analysis
pre-output cross-host cohort reconciliation: adopt actual user leaves, preserving old cohort as engineering evidence; no performance aggregate inspected

observed_trace.producer_service_overlap: For positive-head producer requests, producer and service windows are disjoint. Empty-prefix producer work is already inside service and not added.
observed_trace.unfinished_process_time: Retained launch/failure/interruption receipts and full campaign wall windows; absent receipts are not treated as zero cost.

unmeasured: complete native graph cache hit/miss denominator

native_graph_log_evidence.scope: Existing common native logger only; no extra trace requests. These are logged reuse events, not a complete graph-cache hit rate or per-arm attribution. Shared logger overhead is retained in measured service.
